generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.contactSupport: If the error persists, check the system log or contact your administrator.

not_found.title: Data not found
not_found.explain: The requested record does not exist or was deleted.

validation_failed.title: Invalid input
validation_failed.explain: Please check required fields and formats.

conflict.title: Data conflict
conflict.explain: The record was changed by another process. Refresh and try again.

agent_paused.title: Agent is paused
agent_paused.explain: Resume the agent before assigning work.

approval_already_decided.title: Request already decided
approval_already_decided.explain: This request was previously approved or rejected.

provider_unavailable.title: AI model provider unavailable
provider_unavailable.explain: Check the local model runtime or the cloud API key.

rate_limited.title: Rate limit exceeded
rate_limited.explain: Too many requests at once. Try again in a few minutes.

internal.title: Internal server error
internal.explain: The server hit an unexpected problem. Technical details were logged.

network.title: Network error
network.explain: Cannot reach the local server. Make sure the backend is running.

websocket_disconnected.title: Realtime sync lost
websocket_disconnected.explain: Data may be stale; the system will reconnect automatically.
